question: The members of the society of Khudai Khidmatgars were popularly known as _________. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/04/2021) Shift 2)
options: Blue Shirts
Red Shirts
Black Shirts
Green Shirts
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Red Shirts

Explanation:
The Khudai Khidmatgar society was founded in 1929 by Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan. Its members wore red shirts, hence they were popularly known as 'Red Shirts'. This movement was active in the North-West Frontier Province (now Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) of India. Ghaffar Khan was also called the 'Frontier Gandhi'. The organization was known for its non-violent resistance and played a significant role in the Indian independence movement.

☛ Other name of Red Shirt movement → Khudai Khidmatgar
☛ Known as Frontier Gandhi → Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan
☛ Award conferred on Ghaffar Khan → Bharat Ratna (1987)
☛ Main principle of Khudai Khidmatgars → Non-violence
question_hi: खुदाई खिदमतगार सोसायटी के सदस्यों को सामान्यतः ________ के रूप में जाना जाता था। (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/04/2021) Shift 2)

Explanation:

question: The first Secretary General of United Nations belonged to which of the following countries? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/04/2021) Shift 2)
options: Norway
Sweden
Finland
Portugal
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Norway

Explanation:
The first Secretary General of the United Nations was Trygve Lie, who belonged to Norway. He served from 1946 to 1952. Trygve Lie played a crucial role in the establishment of the United Nations and maintained the organization's strength during the Cold War. He also served as Norway's Foreign Minister. During his tenure, the UN dealt with crises like the Korean War. After Trygve Lie, Dag Hammarskjöld (Sweden) became the second Secretary General. The term of the UN Secretary General is five years, and the appointment is made by the General Assembly on the recommendation of the Security Council.

☛ Who was the second UN Secretary General? → Dag Hammarskjöld

☛ How is the UN Secretary General appointed? → By the General Assembly on the recommendation of the Security Council
question_hi: संयुक्त राष्ट्र के प्रथम महासचिव किस देश से संबंधित थे? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/04/2021) Shift 2)

स्वीडन
फ़िनलैंड
पुर्तगाल

Explanation:
संयुक्त राष्ट्र के प्रथम महासचिव ट्रिग्वे ली थे, जो नॉर्वे से संबंधित थे। उन्होंने 1946 से 1952 तक इस पद पर कार्य किया। ट्रिग्वे ली ने संयुक्त राष्ट्र की स्थापना में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई और शीत युद्ध के दौरान संगठन को मजबूत बनाए रखा। वह नॉर्वे के विदेश मंत्री भी रहे। उनके कार्यकाल में कोरियाई युद्ध जैसे संकटों से निपटा गया। ट्रिग्वे ली के बाद डैग हैमरशोल्ड (स्वीडन) दूसरे महासचिव बने। संयुक्त राष्ट्र के महासचिव का कार्यकाल पांच वर्ष का होता है और इसे सुरक्षा परिषद की सिफारिश पर महासभा द्वारा नियुक्त किया जाता है।

question: The Forest Survey of India under the ministry of Environment of India is located in which city? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/04/2021) Shift 2)
options: Guwahati
Bhopal
Dehradun
New Delhi
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Dehradun

Explanation:
The Forest Survey of India (FSI) is a national organization under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, responsible for assessing and monitoring the forest resources of the country. Its headquarters is located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand. The FSI conducts forest cover mapping, evaluates forest health, carbon stock, and other ecosystem services. Dehradun is known as the 'Forest Capital of India' because it houses several important forest-related institutions like the Forest Research Institute (FRI) and the Indian Institute of Forest Management (IIFM). The FSI was established in 1981 and publishes the biennial 'India State of Forest Report' (ISFR) which provides comprehensive data on forest cover, tree cover, mangrove cover, and forest types.

☛ Headquarters of Forest Survey of India → Dehradun
☛ Year of establishment of Forest Survey of India → 1981
☛ Ministry under which Forest Survey of India works → Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
☛ India's largest forest research institute → Forest Research Institute (FRI), Dehradun
☛ Biennial report published by Forest Survey of India → India State of Forest Report (ISFR)

question: In which country are the Inca ruins of Machu Picchu located? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/04/2021) Shift 2)
options: Guatemala
Greece
Mexico
Peru
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Peru

Explanation:
The Inca ruins of Machu Picchu are located in Peru, a country in South America. Situated in the Andes Mountains at an altitude of approximately 2,430 meters, it was built in the 15th century by the Inca emperor Pachacuti. Machu Picchu is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and is considered one of the New Seven Wonders of the World. It was rediscovered in 1911 by American historian Hiram Bingham. The site is a masterpiece of Inca architecture and engineering, showcasing their advanced construction techniques and integration with the natural landscape.

☛ Which emperor built it? → Pachacuti
☛ Year of rediscovery? → 1911
☛ Who rediscovered it? → Hiram Bingham
☛ In which mountain range is it located? → Andes

question: In which year was the Trade Union Act passed in India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/04/2021) Shift 2)
options: 1964
1911
1926
1947
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1926

Explanation:
The Trade Union Act in India was passed in the year 1926. This Act provides legal recognition to trade unions and regulates their registration, rights, and responsibilities. Under this Act, trade unions are granted immunity from civil and criminal liability and are empowered to engage in collective bargaining. The Act came into effect on June 1, 1927. Its objective is to protect the interests of workers and settle disputes with employers. The Act applies to all unions of workers and employers, ensuring a framework for their functioning.

question: What kind of organisation is NATO(North Atlantic Treaty Organization)? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (06/04/2021) Shift 1)
options: Intergovernmental Military Alliance
Technology Exchange and Development group
Cultural Cooperation and Development Organization
Intergovernmental Economic Cooperation group
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Intergovernmental Military Alliance

Explanation:
NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization) is an intergovernmental military alliance established on 4 April 1949 under the North Atlantic Treaty (Washington Treaty). It currently has 31 member countries and its headquarters is in Brussels, Belgium. It is a military alliance, not a technology, cultural, or economic group.

question: Which among the following countries is not the member of ASEAN? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (07/04/2021) Shift 1)

India
Singapore
solution:

Explanation:

question: Where is the Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park located? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/04/2021) Shift 1)
